- Quality: reranking scores roughly similar, but multi-turn support answers are more terse on Redwood hosted — customer quote: "answers miss context from previous turn sometimes."

- Engineering ran a regen test suite for 120 canonical prompts; attached RED-4123 for regression cases.
- Security team answered SOC2 scope and provided KMS notes (drive doc).
